en-US.title: DDD Dispatch
en-US.subtitle: Calls, texts & roadside jobs
en-US.description: DDD Dispatch helps authorized DDD Roadside Assistance staff handle business calls, customer messages, bookings and service insights. Answer incoming business calls, dial customers, view live transcripts, listen to assisted intake and take over when needed. Keep each customer’s messages, calls and bookings together, claim follow-ups and see what needs attention from Home. Administrators manage staff access, reply reminders and service settings. A connected DDD staff account is required.
en-US.releaseNotes: A simpler Home screen, clearer customer conversations and reply ownership, improved follow-up reminders and service health, cleaner navigation, and our new DDD Dispatch name and Rainbow Road icon.
en-US.promoText: Business calls, customer messages and roadside jobs in one clear staff workspace.

review.notes: This is the DDD Dispatch admin app for DDD Roadside Assistance staff. To review protected read-only features, open the app, enter demo access code 4444, and tap Sign in. The demo code loads synthetic demo inbox, call log, and insights data only. It cannot send texts, place outbound calls, edit Team tech codes, or save live DDD settings. The app connects to the live DDD Dispatch backend at https://google-voice-ai-receptionist.onrender.com. Production phone/SMS/calling features depend on the connected DDD Twilio account and live service data.
